whatItDoes: The handoff command turns useful conversation context into an editable prompt and opens a fresh session. When session persistence is enabled, the replacement links back to the current session.
Before generation, it sends every convertible message from an un-compacted branch; after compaction, it sends the latest summary and retained entries instead. It does not transfer live process state.

whenToReachForIt.invocation: Type /handoff followed by the next session goal.

situations.when: A long session needs a clean continuation
situations.use: Draft a focused brief for a replacement session; persistence preserves the parent link.

situations.when: A new model or context window should continue the work
situations.use: Carry retained context and the next goal across the boundary.

whatItAdds: An explicit, editable context-transfer step between Pi sessions.
A replacement-session flow that preserves a parent link when session persistence is enabled.

howItFits.relationship: The communication prompt can tighten a handoff goal before transfer.
Subagents keep bounded work inside one run; handoff asks a model to select context for a fresh session.

questions.question: What should I review before continuing?
answer: Review the model-generated draft before continuing. Handoff sends every convertible message from an un-compacted branch to the configured model; after compaction, it sends the latest summary and retained entries. It does not transfer live process state.

workingIf: An editable draft appears before session replacement.
The fresh session opens with enough context to act on the stated goal.
setupNotes: Adopted from the MIT-licensed Pi example originally implemented by Mario Zechner; maintained here by Vedang.
The installed source is the local handoff extension in Dotagents.
Parent linkage requires session persistence; ephemeral mode still opens a fresh session without a parent link.
It requires an interactive Pi session, a selected model available through Pi's model runtime, and replacement-session UI support.
